text:
Priya R.: Heads-up: leadership wants a narrow, shippable Console observability slice we can commit to for the next two sprints. Focus: actionable dashboards + basic trace linking + a minimal cost breakdown.
Kai M.: Agree. We should be ruthless about scope. What’s the smallest surface that addresses customer buy criteria?
Nina (cs): Customers are repeatedly asking to surface sudden cost spikes and then jump to context (trace + recent logs). If we can show 'spike -> sample trace' within the Console, that's enough for early pilots.
Riley T.: Ok. I propose a 3-bullet MVP: (A) route-level cost leaderboard (top 15), (B) a per-route 'view traces' pane that surfaces sampled traces with a matching link id, (C) a lightweight error breakdown (5xx vs user error) tied to the route.
Sam (eng): Implementation detail: linking logs -> traces requires propagating a short deterministic correlation id. We can inject at the router and store it with the cost event. Low compute impact.
Kai M.: Sampling policy thoughts? We must trade sampling rate vs storage.
Sam (eng): Default to 0.5% global sampling, bump to 5% for routes that exceed the cost-per-minute threshold. Configurable per-customer via Console toggle.
Priya R.: OK. What are the non-goals for the MVP?
Nina (cs): Full per-user chargebacks, long-term trace retention, and advanced ML anomaly detection are out. Keep it exploratory.
Riley T.: Acceptance criteria draft: 
- Dashboard shows route leaderboard updated every 90s
- Clicking a route shows up to 20 sampled traces from the last 6h with correlation id links to logs
- Cost breakdown shows tokens, model tier, and per-inference average cost for the route
- Sampling control exposed in Console + runtime flag for quick revert
- Error breakdown shows percent 5xx and recent examples
Sam (eng): We should add measurable gating: tracing link success >= 90% for sampled events, dashboard latency < 2m for new data, alert false-positive rate under 1/day on pilot.
Kai M.: Dependencies: needs metrics backfill in ingestion pipeline and a tiny UI widget for in-place trace viewing. Both are 1-week efforts if parallelized.
Priya R.: Risks?
Sam (eng): Storage cost for traces at higher sampling if pilot expands. Ops already flagged retention beyond 24h increases S3 costs.
ops-bot: FYI: projected additional storage for 24h retention at 5% sampling across 3 pilot customers ~ 40GB/day.
Nina (cs): Customer pilot: we have sign-off from Zephyr Labs and one internal beta. They'll validate spike->trace flow.
Riley T.: Rollout plan: sprint A (2w): ingestion + route leaderboard + alert plumbing; sprint B (2w): trace link UI, sampling controls, error breakdown, docs + pilot. Target canary at end of sprint B.
Priya R.: What alerts do we want in MVP? Keep simple: cost-per-minute threshold per-tenant, and an anomaly banner in the Console for top-3 routes.
Sam (eng): I'll own runtime flag and the sampling toggles. PR to track work will be created today.
Kai M.: I can take the dashboard UI. Riley, can you draft the customer acceptance checklist?
Riley T.: Yep. Checklist will include: data accuracy checks (route mapping), spike->trace proof for at least 3 sample spikes, alert noise <= 2/day, and UX copy reviewed.
Priya R.: Who signs off on cost retention/ops spend? Need a number we can show sales.
ops-bot: Request submitted to finance for cost delta estimate. ETA: 48h.
Nina (cs): Customer-facing docs: keep a short walk-through and troubleshooting steps for missing traces. I'll draft.
Priya R.: Final call: do we lock this scope? If yes we'll move to sprint planning.
Kai M.: Locking. Any must-adds before we close?
Sam (eng): Add a quick revert plan (runtime flag + disable sampling) in the runbook.
Riley T.: I'll add that to the checklist.
Priya R.: Great. Locking scope now. Thanks team, I'll publish this and set the planning meeting. :white_check_mark:
